visual_needs_inventory.description: Illustrated vintage steam engine with red boiler, gold trim, and headlamp
Rich wooden freight hopper wagon with brass corners
Cast-iron and brass wheels with rotating counterweights and steel rod
Dani the Robot Conductor in cab window with conductor cap
High-res vibrant Apple, Banana, Carrot, Strawberry illustrations
Tactile wooden cargo crates for math equation interaction
Layered rolling emerald hills, cumulus clouds, smiling sun
Grounded gravel ballast bed and wooden ties
